catchLines.fled: Lechonk snorts the ball into a bush. Drink 1.

Natural 20! His Rattata faints and Joey sobs. Give 4.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Rolled it. Drink 4 standing on your good foot.
Rolled it. Drink 2 standing on your good foot.
Stuck the landing. Give 1 and take a bow.
Natural 20! Stuck the landing. Give 2 and take a bow.

cards.rules: A Caterpie is just sitting there being a little guy. Will the table catch it?

catchLines.caught: Caterpie is yours and bravely stays a worm. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Caterpie inches away. You let it. Drink 1.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It's a Voltorb. It explodes in your hands. Drink 6.

Natural 20! A Togepi hatches and joins the team! Do its cry and give 4.

cards.rules: The clerk makes you run Oak's parcel back to Pallet Town first. Fine. Now he'll sell.

cards.title: Two Paths

catchLines.caught: Oddish is caught and gets planted in your pocket. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Oddish sprouts out of the ball's reach. Drink 1.

catchLines.caught: Diglett is caught by its head. The rest of it was never found. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Diglett drops under the ball and pops up behind you. Drink 1.

catchLines.fled: Pichu zaps the ball into the sky. Drink 1.

elite.title: Lass Tiffany

Natural 20! She backs off out of respect. Give 6.

Natural 20! Critical hit. Give 6.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You found a leg. Finish your drink.
Sticky Web. Drink 4 with your elbows stuck to the table.
Sugar crash for Katy. Give 3.
Natural 20! Sugar crash for Katy. Give 6.

cards.rules: Nessa is a model and you are not. Pout for the camera, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Gigantamax Drednaw. Finish your drink.
Drowned in looks. Drink 4 and keep pouting.
You make the cover. Pick a player: they strike a pose or drink 3.
Natural 20! You make the cover. Pick a player: they strike a pose or drink 6.

cards.title: Brassius
cards.rules: Brassius demands art. Pose as a Pokémon statue. Nobody names it: drink 4.

cards.title: Coolness Contest
cards.rules: Strike your starter's coolest pose for five seconds. Table votes thumbs. Up: give 3. Down: drink 3.

cards.title: Psyduck
cards.rules: Wild Psyduck clutches its head. Clutch yours too. Headache for everyone: drink 2.

strike.even: Wild Psyduck clutches its head. Clutch yours too. Headache for everyone: drink 2.
strike.advantage: Wild Psyduck clutches its head and you cure the headache. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Wild Psyduck's headache turns into Confusion. Drink 4 and spin once.

catchLines.caught: Psyduck is caught and has a headache about it. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Psyduck holds its head and the ball sails past. Drink 1.

cards.title: Machop
cards.rules: Wild Machop wants to arm-wrestle. Flex for the table, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Karate Chop to the junk. Drink 6 and say "thank you, sensei."
Karate Chop to the junk. Drink 3 and say "thank you, sensei."
You flex harder. Pick a player to arm-wrestle you: the loser drinks 2.
Natural 20! You flex harder. Pick a player to arm-wrestle you: the loser drinks 4.

catchLines.caught: Machop is caught and flexes at you. Flex back and give 2.
catchLines.fled: Machop catches the ball and throws it back. Drink 2.

cards.title: Shinx
cards.rules: Wild Shinx sparks and every hair on your body stands up. Static cling. Drink 2.

strike.even: Wild Shinx sparks and every hair on your body stands up. Static cling. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: Wild Shinx sparks, and you wrangle every last one. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Wild Shinx sparks everywhere. Drink 4, hair upright.

catchLines.caught: Shinx is caught and its eyes glow with approval. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Shinx's spark fries the ball. Drink 1.

cards.title: Roggenrola
cards.rules: Wild Roggenrola heard what you said about it. Say something nice, then drink 2.

strike.even: Wild Roggenrola heard what you said about it. Say something nice, then drink 2.
strike.advantage: Wild Roggenrola heard what you said about it. You skip it across a lake. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Wild Roggenrola heard what you said and takes it personally. Drink 4.

catchLines.caught: Roggenrola is caught and hums like a speaker. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Roggenrola just sits there, uncatchable and unimpressed. Drink 1.

cards.title: Pikipek
cards.rules: Wild Pikipek drills a tree. Then your skull. Knock on the table, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Woodpecked. Drink 3 and rub your head.
It finds a better tree. Everyone knocks on the table; the last to stop drinks 2.

dice.doubles: A pair! It drums a beat. Everyone drums the table; the last to stop drinks 3.

catchLines.caught: Pikipek is caught and starts hammering on the ball from inside. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Pikipek pecks the ball into a hole. Drink 1.

cards.title: Nickit
cards.rules: Wild Nickit grabs your drink and runs. Roll d20 to get it back.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You get it back, licked. Finish your drink, then a fresh one.
You get it back, licked. Finish your drink.
Recovered, with a tip. Steal a sip from any drink at the table.
Natural 20! Recovered, with a tip. Steal two sips from any drink at the table.

catchLines.caught: Nickit is caught and is already holding your wallet. Give 2.
catchLines.fled: Nickit steals the ball and runs. Drink 2.

cards.title: Swimmer Brad
cards.rules: Swimmer Brad is in a Speedo on dry land and won't explain. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You looked. Drink 6 and describe what you saw.
You looked. Drink 3 and describe what you saw.
He goes back to the sea. Everyone in shorts drinks 2.
Natural 20! He goes back to the sea. Everyone in shorts drinks 4.

cards.title: Juggler Rico
cards.rules: Juggler Rico juggles three Voltorb. Juggle any two things for 5 seconds or drink 3.

cards.title: Prepare for Trouble
cards.rules: Jessie and James net you from their balloon. Recite their motto, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Netted. Drink 3.
Meowth scratches. Drink 2.
Wobbuffet! Give 1.
They argue about the motto. Give 2.
They blast off again. Give 2.
They blast off again! Everyone points up; the last to point drinks 3.

jinx.name: That's Right!
jinx.rule: The jinxed player ends every sentence with "That's right!" Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Abra
cards.rules: An Abra is asleep. It will teleport the second you move. Throw now?

catchLines.caught: Abra is caught asleep. It never even woke up. Give 3.
catchLines.fled: Abra wakes and teleports away. Drink 2.

cards.title: What? It's Evolving!
cards.rules: Your starter glows in the middle of the road. Everyone hums the evolution music.

cards.title: Cerulean Center
cards.rules: Nurse Joy again. Same face, new town. Everyone swears it's the same one and drinks 1.

cards.title: Cerulean Mart
cards.rules: The bike shop wants a million for a bike. The Mart next door is reasonable.

cards.title: Nugget Bridge
cards.rules: Cross the bridge, trainers and all, or swim under it.

cards.title: Hidden Item
cards.rules: The Itemfinder beeps at a bush. You kick it and something falls out. Give 1.

cards.title: Voltorb
cards.rules: A Poké Ball on the path. Pick it up? It's a Voltorb. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Self-Destruct, in your hand. Drink 6.
Self-Destruct, in your hand. Drink 3.
You roll it to your left neighbor, who drinks 2 and screams.
Natural 20! You roll it to your left neighbor, who drinks 4 and screams.

catchLines.caught: Voltorb is caught, and the table agrees it was a ball the whole time. Give 2.
catchLines.fled: Voltorb rolls off and blows up the ball. Drink 2.

cards.title: Sandshrew
cards.rules: Wild Sandshrew curls up and rolls at your drink. Splash. Drink 2.

strike.even: Wild Sandshrew curls up and rolls at your drink. Splash. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: Wild Sandshrew rolls at your drink, but you catch it like a bowling pin. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Wild Sandshrew rolls at your drink and spills the lot. Drink 4.

catchLines.caught: Sandshrew is caught and rolled up like a snack. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Sandshrew rolls away in a cloud of sand. Drink 1.

cards.title: Bellsprout
cards.rules: Wild Bellsprout sways like it's had six. Sway with it, then wobble. Drink 2.

strike.even: Wild Bellsprout sways like it's had six. Sway with it, then wobble. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: Wild Bellsprout sways like it's had six, then faints into your lap. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Wild Bellsprout sways like it's had six, then Vine Whips you. Drink 4.

catchLines.caught: Bellsprout is caught and wobbles happily. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Bellsprout whips the ball away with a vine. Drink 1.

cards.title: Type Quiz
cards.rules: The drawer names a type. The next player names one that beats it. Wrong drinks 2, right gives 1.

cards.title: Badge Brag
cards.rules: Brag about the last thing you won. Everyone else votes: the weakest brag drinks 2.

cards.title: Daycare Couple
cards.rules: The drawer picks two players to be a Daycare couple. Both drink 1 and name their egg.

cards.title: Contest Pose
cards.rules: Everyone strikes a Contest pose for 5 seconds. The table picks the winner, who gives 3.

cards.title: Name Rater
cards.rules: The Name Rater loves the name of the player on your right. Everyone toasts them and drinks 1.

elite.title: The Recruiter
elite.rules: Nugget Bridge's last man hands you a nugget and a Team Rocket pitch. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! You signed something. Drink 8 and do the Rocket pose.
You signed something. Drink 4 and do the Rocket pose.
You keep the nugget and don't join. Give 3.
Natural 20! You keep the nugget and don't join. Give 6.

elite.title: Cooltrainer Ava
elite.rules: Cooltrainer Ava has six fully evolved Pokémon on Route 3. Rude. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Her Gyarados sweeps. Drink 4.
Her Alakazam reads your mind. Drink 3 and read your last text aloud.
You sweep her back. Everyone sweeps an arm; the slowest drinks 3.
She rage-quits. Give 3.
She asks for your number. Give 4.
She retires on the spot. Give 4.

cards.title: Lt. Surge
cards.rules: Lt. Surge wants to see your service record. Salute him and roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Shocked. Drink 4.
You ground him. Give 4.

dice.doubles: A pair! Paralyzed. Finish your drink.

cards.title: Whitney
cards.rules: Whitney's Miltank used Rollout. It gets worse every hit. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Rollout hits once. Drink 1.
Rollout hits twice. Drink 3.
Three hits. Drink 6.
Four hits. Drink 10.
Whitney bursts into tears. Give 5.

cards.title: Wattson
cards.rules: Wahahaha! Wattson licks a battery and dares you to do the same. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Shocked. Drink {total}.
You lick it first. Give 5.

dice.doubles: A pair! Overcharge. Everyone else drinks {total}.

cards.title: Maylene
cards.rules: Maylene fights barefoot. Shoes off, thumb-war your left neighbor. Lose: drink 5.

cards.title: Burgh
cards.rules: Burgh's art test: finger-draw a bug on your neighbor's back. They can't name it: drink 4.

cards.title: Korrina
cards.rules: Korrina's on skates. Spin 5 times, then walk a straight line. Wobble: drink 5.

cards.title: Lana
cards.rules: Lana lies. Tell two truths and a lie. The table spots the lie: drink 5.

cards.title: Kabu
cards.rules: Kabu jogs every morning. Do ten jumping jacks, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fire Spin. Drink 5, then take a spicy shot.
Burnt out. Drink 5, then ten more jumping jacks.
You outlast the old man. Give 5.
Natural 20! You outlast the old man. Give 10.

cards.title: Iono
cards.rules: Iono is streaming this. Say hi to chat in your best influencer voice, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Banned from chat. Finish your drink.
Chat hates you. Drink 4, then roast yourself like a hater would.
You're trending. Shout out a player by name; they drink 3.
Natural 20! Top donor. Give 8.

cards.title: Good Rod
cards.rules: Roll d20. Each bite wins a prize: reel in to keep them, or cast again and risk them all.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Gyarados. Roar at the table, then drink 6.
A Tentacool stings you on the way up. Drink 3.
A bite! Give 2.
Natural 20! A Lapras surfaces and lets you ride it. Give 4.

cards.title: The Pokérap
cards.rules: Category: Pokémon names, clockwise, no repeats. First to stall or repeat drinks 2.

cards.title: Ponyta
cards.rules: Wild Ponyta, a horse on fire, gallops past. Gallop around your chair, singed. Drink 2.

strike.even: Wild Ponyta, a horse on fire, gallops past. Gallop around your chair, singed. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: Wild Ponyta, a horse on fire, gallops past and you ride it. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Wild Ponyta, a horse on fire, comes back with Flame Wheel. Drink 5.

catchLines.caught: Ponyta is caught, and your hand smells like a hot mane. Give 2.
catchLines.fled: Ponyta gallops off, leaving the ball on fire. Drink 2.

cards.title: Sableye
cards.rules: Wild Sableye eyes your teeth like gems. Grin wide as it licks its lips. Drink 2.

strike.even: Wild Sableye eyes your teeth like gems. Grin wide as it licks its lips. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: Wild Sableye mistakes your teeth for gems, finds out they're fake, and cries. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Wild Sableye eyes your teeth like gems and takes a sip of your drink. Drink 5.

catchLines.caught: Sableye is caught and shows you its gem. It is not for sale. Give 2.
catchLines.fled: Sableye grins and vanishes with the ball. Drink 2.

cards.title: Croagunk
cards.rules: Wild Croagunk pokes your kidney and laughs. Poke your right neighbor, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Poison Jab. Drink 3 and say "ow" like a toad.
You poke back harder. Your right neighbor drinks 3 and groans.

dice.doubles: A pair! Croagunk laughs at the player you poked. They drink {total}.

catchLines.caught: Croagunk is caught and croaks a threat. Give 2.
catchLines.fled: Croagunk pokes you with a poison finger. Drink 2.

cards.title: Sandile
cards.rules: Wild Sandile wears sunglasses and doesn't care about you. Awkward. Drink 2 to break the silence.

strike.even: Wild Sandile wears sunglasses and doesn't care about you. Awkward. Drink 2 to break the silence.
strike.advantage: Wild Sandile wears sunglasses and doesn't care. Then you steal the sunglasses. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Wild Sandile wears sunglasses and didn't care until now. Now it cares. Drink 5.

catchLines.caught: Sandile is caught and looks cool in sunglasses. Give 2.
catchLines.fled: Sandile slides back into the sand. Drink 1.

cards.title: Hawlucha
cards.rules: Wild Hawlucha leaps off a tree and elbow-drops the table. Slam it, then roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Flying Press. Drink 4.
Body Slam. Drink 2 while your left neighbor counts to three.
You kick out at two. Give 2.
You pin it for the three count. Give 3.
Tag team: pick a partner; you both give 2.
Off the top rope! Stand on your chair and give 4.

catchLines.caught: Hawlucha is caught and strikes a pose. Pose back, give 2.
catchLines.fled: Hawlucha does a flip over the ball. Drink 2.

cards.title: Mudbray
cards.rules: Wild Mudbray, a donkey caked in mud, wants to share. It shares. Drink 2.

strike.even: Wild Mudbray, a donkey caked in mud, wants to share. It shares. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: Wild Mudbray wants to share its mud, and you win the mud wrestle. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Wild Mudbray wants to share its mud and hits you with Mud Slap. Drink 5.

catchLines.caught: Mudbray is caught and kicks you anyway. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Mudbray kicks the ball into a ditch. Drink 1.

cards.title: Biker Gang
cards.rules: The Biker Gang revs at you on Cycling Road. Make the engine noise, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The whole gang runs you over. Make the engine noise, then finish your drink.
Run over. Drink {total}.
They wipe out. Give 3 to whoever looks most like they own a motorcycle.
Natural 20! They wipe out. Give 6 to whoever looks most like they own a motorcycle.

cards.title: Psychic Tyron
cards.rules: Think of a number from 1 to 5. Your left neighbor guesses it. Right: drink 3.

cards.title: Snorlax Blocks the Way
cards.rules: A Snorlax is asleep across the road. Play the Poké Flute (hum loudly) and roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: It rolls onto you. Drink 3.
It rolls onto you and your left neighbor. You both drink 2.
It snores and doesn't move. Drink 2 and hum louder.
It wakes up and wanders off. Give 2.
It wakes up hungry. Whoever has the most food nearby drinks 2.
It wakes up and rolls away. Give 3.

cards.title: Lapras
cards.rules: A man in Silph Co. says the Lapras in the tank is yours if you can catch it.

catchLines.caught: Lapras is yours. Everyone hums its song and gives 2.
catchLines.fled: Lapras sings sadly and sails off. Everyone hums it and drinks 2.

cards.title: Evolution Stone
cards.rules: A shop sells evolution stones for the price of your dignity. Your starter wants one.

cards.title: Celadon Center
cards.rules: Celadon's Pokémon Center has a Game Corner next door. Everyone resists. Toast to resisting.

cards.title: Celadon Department
cards.rules: Five floors of shopping and a rooftop vending machine. The clerk is drunk.

cards.title: Game Corner
cards.rules: Walk past the Game Corner, or go in and see who's still at the tables.

cards.title: Slot Machine
cards.rules: One more pull. You can feel it. Pull or walk?

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! The house wins. Drink 8.
The house wins. Drink 4.
Jackpot! Everyone cheers; the quietest drinks 4.
Natural 20! Jackpot! Everyone cheers; the quietest drinks 8.

cards.title: Wingull
cards.rules: Wild Wingull snatches a chip out of your hand. Rude. Drink 2.

strike.even: Wild Wingull snatches a chip out of your hand. Rude. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: Wild Wingull snatches a chip out of your hand, and you snatch it back. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: Wild Wingull snatches a chip out of your hand and brings friends. Drink 5.

catchLines.caught: Wingull is caught and wants your fries. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Wingull steals the ball and your lunch. Drink 1.

cards.title: Ralts
cards.rules: Wild Ralts senses your feelings and looks worried. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! It cries with you. Drink 6 for your feelings.
It cries with you. Drink 3 for your feelings.
It cheers up. Compliment the player on your left, then give 3.
Natural 20! It cheers up. Compliment the player on your left, then give 6.

catchLines.caught: Ralts is caught and can feel what you feel. Give 2, and feel it.
catchLines.fled: Ralts senses the throw coming and steps aside. Drink 2.

cards.title: Phanpy
cards.rules: Wild Phanpy sprays you with its trunk. Trumpet back, then roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Rollout, right into your chair. Drink 3 and scoot back.
You out-trumpet it. Everyone trumpets; the weakest trumpet drinks 3.

catchLines.caught: Phanpy is caught and rolls around in your lap. Give 1.
catchLines.fled: Phanpy rolls over the ball and flattens it. Drink 1.

cards.title: Gotcha!
cards.rules: On three, everyone points at a player. Any two who point at each other both drink 2.

cards.title: Safari Toss
cards.rules: Flick a coaster into an empty cup across the table, one try. In: give 3. Miss: drink 2.

cards.title: Poké Flute
cards.rules: The drawer hums a lullaby. The first player to yawn or sigh drinks 2.

cards.title: Lost Item
cards.rules: Everyone checks their pockets. The player with the fewest things in them drinks 2.

cards.title: Rival's Rant
cards.rules: Insult the player on your left in your best rival voice. If the table finds it weak, drink 2.

cards.title: Sun Stone
cards.rules: A Sun Stone glows in a flower patch. Your starter leans toward it.

elite.title: Rocket Executive
elite.rules: Behind the poster: a Rocket executive with a Raticate the size of a dog. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hyper Fang to the shin. Drink 8 and hop.
Hyper Fang to the shin. Drink 4 and hop.
He drops the Silph Scope. Point it at a player: they drink 4 and confess a guilty pleasure.
Natural 20! He drops the Silph Scope. Point it at a player: they drink 8 and confess a guilty pleasure.

elite.title: Gambler Lou
elite.rules: Gambler Lou bets his whole stack. Push your drink to the middle, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He takes the pot. Drink 8.
He takes the pot. Drink 4.
You clean him out. Pick a player to pay your winnings: they drink 4 and call you boss.
Natural 20! He hands over his lucky coin too. Give 8.

cards.title: Erika
cards.rules: Erika's Sleep Powder. Shut your eyes and roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Asleep. Drink 6 with your eyes shut.
Asleep. Drink 5 with your eyes shut.
Asleep. Drink 4 with your eyes shut.
Asleep. Drink 3 with your eyes shut.
You shake it off. Give 4.

cards.title: Morty
cards.rules: Morty's Gastly stares. Out-stare the player opposite you. Blink first: drink 4.

cards.title: Flannery
cards.rules: Flannery is new and nervous and set the gym on fire. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Burned. Take a high-proof or spicy shot.
You douse her. Give a shot.

cards.title: Crasher Wake
cards.rules: Crasher Wake makes a splash. Blow bubbles in your drink for 5 seconds, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Swallowed by the wave. Finish your drink.
Hydro Pump. Drink 5, then blow more bubbles.
You ride his wave. Give 5.
Natural 20! You wipe him out. Give a shot.

cards.title: Elesa
cards.rules: Elesa wants a runway walk. Strut to the door and back. Table scores you under 7/10: drink 5.

cards.title: Ramos
cards.rules: Ramos is 90 and tougher than you. Talk like a grumpy grandpa, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Rototilled. Finish your drink.
Leech Seed. Drink 5, and your right neighbor steals a sip of yours.
You prune the old man. Give 5 in his grumpy voice.
Natural 20! You prune the old man. Give 10 in his grumpy voice.

cards.title: Kiawe
cards.rules: Kiawe's fire dance. Shirt off or hips going, the table picks. Then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Third-degree burns. Drink 5, then take a spicy shot.
Burned. Drink 5 and keep dancing.
Totem Marowak falls. Give 5.
Natural 20! Inferno Overdrive. Give a shot.

cards.title: Bea
cards.rules: Bea trains hard. Hold a plank for 30 seconds. Drop early: drink 6.

cards.title: Kofu
cards.rules: Kofu sells fish. Sell your drink to the table in 20 seconds. Nobody buys it: drink 5.

cards.title: Rocket Grunt
cards.rules: A Rocket Grunt guards the basement under the Game Corner. He has a Zubat. Of course. Roll 2d6.

outcomes.instruction: Zubat. Of course. Drink 3.
He gives up the Lift Key. Give 3.

dice.doubles: A pair! Jackpot on the slots upstairs. Give {total}.

cards.title: Slowpoke Tail Seller
cards.rules: A Grunt sells twitching Slowpoke Tails. You buy one out of fear. Drink 2, slowly.

strike.even: A Grunt sells twitching Slowpoke Tails. You buy one out of fear. Drink 2, slowly.
strike.advantage: A Grunt sells twitching Slowpoke Tails until you free the Slowpoke. Give 4, very slowly.
strike.disadvantage: A Grunt sells twitching Slowpoke Tails and sells you two. Drink 5, slowly.

cards.title: Spinner Tiles
cards.rules: A Grunt laughs as you spin on the spinner tiles. Dizzy. Drink 2.

strike.even: A Grunt laughs as you spin on the spinner tiles. Dizzy. Drink 2.
strike.advantage: A Grunt laughs as you ride the spinner tiles, then you spin into him. Give 3.
strike.disadvantage: A Grunt laughs as you spin on the spinner tiles. Drink 5, then walk a straight line.

cards.title: Giovanni
cards.rules: Giovanni strokes his Persian and doesn't look up. Roll d6.

outcomes.instruction: Persian's Slash. Drink 5.
Earthquake. Drink 4 and kiss his ring.
He looks up. Give 4.
He finally looks worried. Give 4.
Persian switches sides. Give 4 and meow.
He says you remind him of his son. Give 5.

phases.rules: He stands up. Staring contest with your left neighbor, playing Giovanni. Blink first: drink 4.

cards.title: Drasna
cards.rules: Drasna is a sweet granny with four dragons. Kiss your left neighbor's cheek, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Granny's dragon. Finish your drink.
Dragon Pulse. Drink 6, and your left neighbor pinches your cheek.
Granny's proud and slips you cookie money. Give 5.
Natural 20! Granny's proud and slips you cookie money. Give 10.

cards.title: Acerola
cards.rules: Hide your drink. Your left neighbor hunts it for 15 seconds. Found: drink 5.

cards.title: Kahili
cards.rules: Kahili golfs. Flick a bottle cap into a cup across the table in 3 tries. All miss: drink 5.

cards.title: Molayne
cards.rules: Molayne fixes computers. Let the table read your last web search, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Clear your history. Finish your drink.
Flash Cannon. Drink 5, and the table reads one more search.
You reboot him. Pick a player: the table reads their last search or they drink 4.
Natural 20! You reboot him. Pick a player: the table reads their last search or they drink 8.

cards.title: Marnie
cards.rules: Lead the table in a Team Yell chant for Marnie. Anyone sits it out: you drink 5.

cards.title: Hop
cards.rules: Hop is Leon's little brother and he won't stop saying so. Say "Mate!" then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Still not Leon. Drink 10.
Still not Leon. Drink 5.
He cries to his brother. Give 5.
Natural 20! Unbeatable! Everyone else drinks 3.

jinx.name: Mate
jinx.rule: The jinxed player ends every sentence with "mate." Slip: drink 1.

cards.title: Bede
cards.rules: Bede is a brat. Throw a 10-second tantrum. Table says too tame: drink 5.

cards.title: Allister
cards.rules: Allister hides behind a mask. Cover your face with your hands, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Gigantamax Gengar. Finish your drink.
Shadow Ball. Drink 5 with your face still covered.
Peekaboo! The first player to flinch drinks 4.
Natural 20! Peekaboo! The first player to flinch drinks 8.

cards.title: Rika
cards.rules: Rika runs the interview. Name your three worst habits in 10 seconds. Stall: drink 5.

cards.title: Poppy
cards.rules: Poppy is eight and has a hammer. Let your left neighbor bonk your head, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Bonked silly. Finish your drink.
Gigaton Hammer. Drink 5, and your left neighbor bonks you again.
You take her toy. Bonk a player once; they drink 3.
Natural 20! You take her toy. Bonk a player once; they drink 6.

cards.title: Larry
cards.rules: It's Larry again. He's on unpaid overtime. Sigh with him, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Unpaid overtime. Drink 12 and sigh again, sadder.
Unpaid overtime. Drink 6 and sigh again, sadder.
Larry gets to go home. Give 5.
Natural 20! Larry smiles. Everyone else drinks 4.

cards.title: Hassel
cards.rules: Hassel weeps at art. Describe the table like a painting. Nobody is moved: drink 5.

cards.title: Crispin
cards.rules: Crispin is on nine energy drinks. Talk at double speed for 10 seconds, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Heart palpitations. Finish your drink.
Burnout. Drink 5, then talk at half speed until your next turn.
He crashes. Whoever looks most tired drinks 3.
Natural 20! He crashes. Whoever looks most tired drinks 6.

cards.title: Amarys
cards.rules: Amarys hates friends. Get a neighbor to say "friend" in 30 seconds or drink 5.

cards.title: Lacey
cards.rules: Lacey's pop quiz: count down from 30 by threes in 15 seconds. Slip once: drink 5.

cards.title: Drayton
cards.rules: Drayton couldn't be bothered to read this card. Neither could you. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He beats you without trying. Drink 12.
He beats you without trying. Drink 6.
You tried harder. Give 5, with minimal effort.
Natural 20! You tried harder. Give 10, with minimal effort.

cards.title: Blue
cards.rules: Blue got here first and won't shut up about it. The whole table fights. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Blue sweeps your team. Everyone finishes their drink, then a fresh one.
Blue sweeps your team. Everyone finishes their drink.
Close fight. Everyone drinks 4 and says "smell ya later."
A clean hit. Hand out 10.
Natural 20! A clean hit. Hand out 20.

phases.rules: His last Pokémon beats your starter. Of course it does. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Smell ya later. Everyone drinks 8.
Smell ya later. Everyone drinks 4.
Blue's out. Everyone else drinks 4.
Natural 20! Blue's out. Everyone else drinks 8.

cards.title: Red
cards.rules: Red hasn't spoken since 1996. The table fights in silence. Anyone talks: drink 2. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Red says nothing. Everyone finishes their drink.
Pikachu Volt Tackles the table. Everyone drinks 4 in silence.
A hit on Mt. Silver. Everyone who stayed silent gives 2.
Natural 20! Red nods once. Give 10.

phases.rules: Pikachu, at level 88. Roll d20 in silence.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Thunder. Everyone drinks 8.
Thunder. Everyone drinks 4.
Red nods once. Give 6.
Natural 20! Red nods once. Give 12.

cards.title: Lance
cards.rules: Lance used Hyper Beam on the whole table. Roll d20 and pray.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Hyper Beam sweeps the table. Everyone finishes their drink, then a fresh one.
Hyper Beam sweeps the table. Everyone finishes their drink.
Dragonite's Outrage. Everyone drinks 3 and yells.
Dragonite staggers. Make a rule for the rest of the game.
Natural 20! Dragonite staggers. Make two rules for the rest of the game.

phases.rules: Dragonite, with a cape. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Outrage. Everyone drinks 8.
Outrage. Everyone drinks 4.
Dragonite bows. Give 6.
Natural 20! Dragonite bows. Give 12.

cards.title: Steven
cards.rules: Steven wants to show the whole table his rock collection. Roll 2d6 to escape.

outcomes.instruction: Meteor Mash. Everyone drinks {total}.
Metagross staggers. Give {total}, split however you like.

phases.rules: Metagross Mega Evolves. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Meteor Mash. Everyone drinks 8.
Meteor Mash. Everyone drinks 4.
It cracks like a geode. Give 6.
Natural 20! It cracks like a geode. Give 12.

cards.title: Wallace
cards.rules: Wallace wants a beautiful fight. Everyone strikes a fabulous pose, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Milotic sweeps. Everyone finishes their drink.
Ugly. Everyone drinks 3; the table names the ugliest pose and that player drinks 2 more.
Stunning hit. The table names the best pose; that player gives 4.
Natural 20! Ribbon-worthy. Make a rule for the rest of the game.

phases.rules: Milotic, glittering. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Too beautiful to hit. Everyone drinks 8.
Too beautiful to hit. Everyone drinks 4.
Ruffled. Give 6.
Natural 20! Ruffled. Give 12.

cards.title: Cynthia
cards.rules: Cynthia's Garchomp has never lost. The whole table holds hands and prays, then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Garchomp sweeps the table. Everyone finishes their drink.
Earthquake. Everyone drinks 4 without letting go of hands.
Garchomp flinches. Give 4, and everyone lets go.
Natural 20! Cynthia drops her hair clip. Give 10.

phases.rules: Garchomp, again. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Earthquake. Everyone drinks 8.
Earthquake. Everyone drinks 4.
Garchomp falls. Cynthia smiles. Give 6.
Natural 20! Garchomp falls. Cynthia smiles. Give 12.

cards.title: Alder
cards.rules: Alder skipped work to get drunk with you. The whole table cheers him, then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! He's still up at 4 a.m. Everyone finishes their drink.
Volcarona burns the table. Everyone drinks 3 and blows on their fingers.
Alder spills his beer on you. Give 4 and sip anyone's drink.
Natural 20! Alder nods off mid-battle. Give 10.

phases.rules: Volcarona, and it's very warm in here. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Fiery Dance. Everyone drinks 8.
Fiery Dance. Everyone drinks 4.
It cools off. Give 6.
Natural 20! It cools off. Give 12.

cards.title: Iris
cards.rules: Iris is the Champion and she's literally a child. The whole table fights a kid. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Outrage. Everyone finishes their drink.
Beaten by a child. Everyone drinks 4 and apologizes to her.
You land one on a kid. The table boos you; give 4 anyway.
Natural 20! You send her to bed. Give 10.

phases.rules: Haxorus, and she's already crying. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Dragon Dance. Everyone drinks 8.
Dragon Dance. Everyone drinks 4.
You beat a kid. Give 6, ashamed.
Natural 20! You beat a kid. Give 12, ashamed.

cards.title: Diantha
cards.rules: Diantha is a movie star. The whole table acts out a dramatic death, then you roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Box-office flop. Everyone finishes their drink.
Moonblast. Everyone drinks 4; the worst death scene drinks 2 more.
An award-worthy hit. Thank the Academy, then give 4.
Natural 20! Standing ovation. Give 10.

phases.rules: Her final scene. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! She steals the scene. Everyone drinks 8.
She steals the scene. Everyone drinks 4.
Cut! That's a wrap. Give 6.
Natural 20! Cut! That's a wrap. Give 12.

cards.title: Professor Kukui
cards.rules: Professor Kukui fights shirtless in a lab coat. The whole table yells "Woo!" Then roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Lab coat to the face. Everyone finishes their drink.
Woo! Everyone drinks 3 and flexes.
A hit, cousin! Pick a cousin at the table; you both give 2.
Natural 20! Woo! Give 10.

phases.rules: Incineroar, shirtless too. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Darkest Lariat. Everyone drinks 8.
Darkest Lariat. Everyone drinks 4.
Woo! Give 6.
Natural 20! Woo! Give 12.

cards.title: Leon
cards.rules: Leon has never lost a battle, only his way. Everyone strikes the Charizard pose. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Still undefeated. Everyone finishes their drink.
G-Max Wildfire. Everyone drinks 4, still holding the pose.
Leon got lost on the way back. Point in a random direction and give 4.
Natural 20! His cape falls off. Give 10.

phases.rules: Charizard Gigantamaxes. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! G-Max Wildfire. Everyone drinks 8.
G-Max Wildfire. Everyone drinks 4.
The champion time is over. Give 6.
Natural 20! The champion time is over. Give 12.

cards.title: Geeta
cards.rules: Geeta booked your fight in a meeting. The whole table says "per my last email." Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Mandatory overtime. Everyone finishes their drink.
Tera Blast. Everyone drinks 4 and replies all.
The meeting ends early. Give 4 and leave the room for 5 seconds.
Natural 20! You take over the meeting. Give 10.

phases.rules: Glimmora Terastallizes. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Tera Blast. Everyone drinks 8.
Tera Blast. Everyone drinks 4.
Meeting adjourned. Give 6.
Natural 20! Meeting adjourned. Give 12.

cards.title: Nemona
cards.rules: Nemona wants to battle you again. And again. And again. The whole table fights. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! One more battle! Everyone finishes their drink.
Rematch! Everyone drinks 3 and says "one more!"
She loves it. Give 4, and hug your left neighbor for her.
Natural 20! She needs a water break. Give 10.

phases.rules: Pawmot, and she's never been happier. Roll d20.

outcomes.instruction: Natural 1! Again! Everyone drinks 8.
Again! Everyone drinks 4.
She finally loses. She loves it. Give 6.
Natural 20! She finally loses. She loves it. Give 12.
